housing: Most Oklahoma City renters live in single-family houses or garden-style apartment complexes spread across a very large city area. Older core neighborhoods add bungalows, duplexes and garage apartments.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid Services of Oklahoma
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for renters facing eviction

climate: Ask where to shelter in a tornado, test the heating and air conditioning, and photograph the roof, windows and siding for hail damage, which is common in spring storms.
universities: University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center
fact: Oklahoma City covers more than 600 square miles, so most rentals are houses and apartment complexes rather than downtown flats.
